Upcoming event · IEEE CASS Jadavpur University

CAScade

Student Orientation & TCAD Workshop

Meet the chapter and explore embedded hardware at the open orientation. Go deeper into the realm of silicon at the hands-on Sentaurus TCAD workshop.

Explore orientation Explore the TCAD workshop Workshop registration

The CAScade programme

Part 1 · Day 1

Student orientation

Proposed date
8 January 2027
Proposed venue
Department of Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering, Prayukti Bhawan, Jadavpur University

Open to all students. The session is designed especially for first- and second-year students who want to join the chapter.

Meet the team, learn about IEEE membership, and find out how to join chapter projects and design competitions. In the second half, see how circuits, sensors and firmware work together in an embedded system.

  • Explore sensing, power regulation and communication through a flight controller case study.

Win a take-home electronics kit. Take the technical quiz for a chance to win a small kit you can use to keep experimenting after CAScade. Build your first prototype in a short, hands-on follow-up session, then try your own ideas at home.

Part 2 · Days 2 and 3

Hands-on Sentaurus TCAD workshop

Proposed dates
9–10 January 2027
Proposed venue
IC-CoE, Prayukti Bhawan, Jadavpur University

Who can apply? B.E. students in Year 2 or above, along with M.Tech and Ph.D. students, in electrical engineering, electronics, instrumentation or a related circuital discipline.

What you should know. Bring a foundation in semiconductor devices or circuit fundamentals. The workshop is designed for students interested in VLSI, device modelling or related fields.

Day 2 · Semiconductor device simulation

Use Sentaurus SDEVICE and SVISUAL to model FinFETs and gate-all-around transistors, extract current–voltage curves, and visualise electrical potential.

Day 3 · Fabrication process simulation

Use Sentaurus SPROCESS and Structure Editor to model implantation, diffusion, oxidation and etching, then build 3D device structures and refine their meshes.

Workshop registration

Use this form to apply for both days of the Sentaurus TCAD workshop. Submitting an application does not confirm a seat.
